newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-May fixed asset investment up 14 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-May fixed asset investment up 14 pct.

text.p: China's fixed asset investment rose 14 percent to 356.3 billion yuan ($42.9 billion) in the first five months of 1997 compared with the year-ago period, the State Statistical Bureau said on Wednesday.
The rate of increase was one percentage point lower compared with the January to April period, the bureau said.
Investment in real estate fell for the first time in several years, slipping 2.9 percent in May to 65.1 billion yuan, it said without giving a figure for the first five months.
The bureau said investment in basic infrastructure jumped 20.4 percent in the first five months to 206.1 billion yuan.
Investment in the agricultural sector skyrocketed a year-on-year 98.3 percent to 9.9 billion yuan between January and May, it said.
